name: inv-11-one-request-marker-parser
description: A spawned task's authority markers (LOOM_REQUEST_ID, LOOM_CONTEXT_DIGEST) have one writer and one reader, both in engine/src/core/spawn-task-text.ts: renderSpawnTaskText writes them and parseIssuedTaskIdentity reads them back as unbound | malformed | bound. Three readers once disagreed (Claude's correlator ignored the digest and refused an identical repeat, Pi's required exactly one of each and skipped non-matching lines, the emission capability accepted identical repeats), so the same prompt meant different authority on each harness. A module that spells a marker in code (a string or regex literal naming it, or the marker-line text) is the next disagreeing reader; prose in a comment defines nothing and is not matched.
fixHint: Read a task's markers with parseIssuedTaskIdentity (and write them only through renderSpawnTaskText) from engine/src/core/spawn-task-text.ts; resolve the run that issued the identity with resolveIssuingRun from engine/src/orchestration/session-run-bindings.ts.
